description: Development-only settings. Enables dev features and overrides for local testing.

auth.description: Authentication provider to use. Currently supported: 'supabase' (default). Other values default to supabase.

database.description: Database provider to use. Currently supported: 'supabase' (default). Other values default to supabase.

analytics.description: Analytics exporter to use. Currently supported: 'sentry' (default). Handles analytics event buffering and dispatch.

errorProvider.description: Error tracking provider to use. Currently supported: 'sentry' (default). Handles exception capture, user identification, and breadcrumbs.

splashScreen.description: Show splash screen on app load (after bootstrap + 1s buffer)

debugLogs.description: Enable verbose debug logging throughout the app

loggerCategories.description: Configure which logger categories are enabled

consent.description: Default analytics consent level on first app launch. Options: 'none' (no tracking), 'basic' (GDPR minimum), 'full' (all tracking). Default 'basic' is privacy-first and GDPR-compliant.

buffer.description: Analytics event buffer configuration (dev: same as production for testing purposes). endpoint: set via EXPO_PUBLIC_ANALYTICS_ENDPOINT or config value.

breadcrumbs.description: Sentry breadcrumb queue configuration (dev: same as production).

dispatch.description: Event dispatch configuration (dev: same as production).

performanceBaseline.description: Performance baseline tracking configuration (dev: verbose explanation for debugging). Enable/disable via featureFlags.track-performance-baseline. maxSamplesPerOp: max samples per operation (FIFO rolling window, prevents unbounded storage). warmupSamples: skip first N samples to prevent cold-start skew (e.g., 5). regressionThresholdPct: threshold for regression alert as % above p95 (e.g., 20%). percentileForCompare: which percentile to use for regression detection (e.g., 95).

sentry.description: Enable/disable Sentry as analytics exporter (dev: enabled for testing)

exporters.description: Exporter enable/disable settings (dev: same as production).

api.description: Request manager (dev: shorter timeouts for faster feedback)

backgroundJobs.description: Job queue configuration (dev: faster for testing)

circuitBreaker.description: Circuit breaker thresholds (dev: faster failure detection and recovery)

entitlements.description: Entitlement lifecycle and reminder configuration (dev: debug logging enabled)

adaptivePayload.description: Adaptive payload overrides (dev: compression disabled for easier debugging, lower threshold for testing)

telemetry.description: Network telemetry sampling (healthCheck: 10%, errors: 50%, maxQueue: 1000 events)

network.description: Network connectivity detection settings (pingInterval: 20 minutes, debounce: 100ms in dev for faster testing)

ios.platformNotes: iOS overrides (dev): Even stricter thresholds (1000ms vs 2000ms base dev) for aggressive testing of performance edge cases on slow devices. Faster health checks (30s) for quicker feedback.

android.platformNotes: Android overrides (dev): Same aggressive strictness as iOS. Tests worst-case performance on variable hardware.

web.platformNotes: Web overrides (dev): Less aggressive than base (3000ms vs 2500ms). Allows for deliberate throttling in DevTools while still catching real slowness.

desktop.platformNotes: Desktop overrides (dev): Balanced between mobile and web. Tests performance on typical developer machine.

offline.description: Offline queue overrides (dev: smaller queue size, faster retries for testing)

remoteConfig.description: Remote config sync settings. Clock skew tolerance: 60s (allows ±60s device clock drift before denying entitlements). Entitlement poll interval: 1 minute (dev: faster testing).

safeMode.description: Safe mode health check configuration (dev: faster health checks). Storage: 30s, Auth: 1m

storage.description: Cache cleanup interval (1 minute in dev)

navDrawer.description: Global NavDrawer sidebar toggle. skipRoutes=first-segment opt-out; skipPaths=exact-path exceptions. Dev has common auth/onboarding routes skipped.

topBar.description: Route groups that hide the top chrome bar. Same as production.

bottomBar.description: Route groups that show the bottom chrome bar. Same as production.

chrome.description: Chrome visibility policy. Inherits production defaults.

compression.description: Cache compression middleware configuration (dev: aggressive 512B threshold, 100% sampling for testing)

cacheSecurityLimits.description: Hard security limits for cache growth (dev: warn on oversized entries instead of rejecting for easier testing)

cacheCapacity.description: LRU cache capacity management (dev: 50MB limit, 95% soft threshold, 80% target post-eviction). More lenient than production for easier testing and debugging.

navigationPolicy.description: Navigation policy mode (dev: same as production for consistency). Override here to test other modes (e.g., 'public_by_default').

featureFlags.description: Max ms to wait for remote flag sync before continuing startup with a fallback.

networkConditions.description: Dev uses higher multipliers for very generous debugging timeouts across all network types

config.description: App config loading (hardcoded timeout, no network)

preload.description: Font and image preloading for UI

network.description: Network state detection and speed classification

jobSetup.description: Background job queue and subscription setup

auth.description: Auth state evaluation + deferred sync setup

featureFlags.description: Feature flag bootstrap + hardcoded fallback seeding

registration.description: Server registry finalization + job handler registration

kernel.description: Dev overrides: networkConditions multipliers (1.5-5.0x) much higher than production for generous debugging. phaseTiming baseMs same as production (shared baseline). Example: services on dev wifi = 3500 * 1.5 = 5250ms vs. prod = 3500 * 1.0 = 3500ms. config phase baseMs reduced to 300ms in dev for faster iteration.
